description: Coded democratic-participation TARGET registry entry — one record per organ × channel-kind, holding the organ (議会 / 行政機関 / 選管) / channel / 根拠法令 / 提出様式 / 期限 / 紹介議員-required flag so a moushibumi cell can route + (eventually) file procedurally (ADR-2605312400 §2). OPEN DATA (derived from the organ's published guidance; provenance mandatory). CONSTITUTIONAL: `verificationStatus` gates live submission (G14); `channelKind=election-info` entries are INFO-ONLY (G3 — neutral reference to official sources, no campaigning/endorsement/GOTV; no submission channel). Never fabricate (G8): `legalBasis` + `provenance` mandatory.

organ.description: The 議会 / 行政機関 / 選管 responsible

channelType.description: HOW the voice is filed (or info-only)

introducingMemberRequired.description: 請願 to the Diet requires a 紹介議員 (国会法 §79); moushibumi notes the requirement, never arranges/lobbies one (G9)

submissionForm.description: 提出様式 description (or info-only note)

deadline.description: Comment window / 会期 / 締切 description

legalBasis.description: 根拠法令 — MANDATORY (G8), e.g. '請願法; 国会法 §79' / '行政手続法 §39'

provenance.description: Source URL (the organ's published guidance) — MANDATORY (G8)

verificationStatus.description: G14 submission gate. unverified-seed => routing/info-design only, NO live submission.
